name: The Dead Rabbit
address: 30 Water St (near Broad St), New York, NY 10004
status_note: Open daily per the official site (thedeadrabbit.com) with live Resy booking. WARNING: deadrabbitnyc.com now serves an unrelated football-streaming page, and deadrabbit.com is a podcast, so don't link either. The phone number comes from third-party listings, not the official site.

dress.detail: The official FAQ gives no dress code; reviews describe a busy, come-as-you-are pub downstairs.

sources.name: The Dead Rabbit official Help & FAQs

age.value: 21+ in the Parlor; under-21s are allowed in the Taproom before 9pm only with a parent or guardian, seated at a table

sources.name: The Dead Rabbit official Help & FAQs

cover.value: None listed (some live-music nights are ticketed via Eventbrite/Resy)

sources.name: The Dead Rabbit official Help & FAQs

getting_in.value: Reservations on Resy recommended, especially for the Parlor; walk-ins always kept. Taproom bar seats are first come, first served. Table limits are 90 min for walk-ins and 2 hr for reservations.

sources.name: The Dead Rabbit official Help & FAQs

hours.value: Taproom: Sun–Thu 11am–2am, Fri–Sat 11am–3am. Parlor: Tue–Sat 5pm–1am, Sun 4pm–12am, closed Mon.

sources.name: The Dead Rabbit official Help & FAQs

price.value: Cocktails ~$18–25; a 20% service charge on the bill has been reported

subway.value: Whitehall St (R/W), ~3 min walk; South Ferry (1) and Bowling Green (4/5) are also close (estimated from the address)

sources.name: The Dead Rabbit official Help & FAQs
